freeze_rule: Up to 4 non-branded prompts may be swapped once GSC query data is readable; after that the panel is frozen for all rounds.
settings: Fresh conversation; memory/personalization off; ChatGPT search on; Claude web search on; Gemini default; Egypt IP. Consumer apps only — API results are never mixed in.

metrics.mention_rate: completed answers that name LenAqar / completed answers

metrics.reporting: raw counts + denominators per product; failed/skipped runs reported separately; branded and non-branded never mixed
